units: <cite ref="Beitzah 22a">Bets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ שרי</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="S01522"><he>קִנְבָּא</he></cite>, Rashi Ms. <cite ref="S01020"><he>קִינְבָּא</he></cite>; Ms. M. <cite ref="S01048"><he>קינסא</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) to snuff (or trim) the wick is permitted (on the Holy Days).

senses.gloss: קניבת ירק (or קְנוֹבֶת) those parts of vegetables which are stripped off, refuse.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 3:3">Eduy. III, 3</cite>; Y. Ter. XI, 48ᵃ top.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 4:4">Tosef. Dem. IV, 4</cite> <he>קנו׳ י׳ שבגינה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>קני׳</he>) the cut off portions of vegetables trimmed in the garden.
Tosef. Ter. IX, 10 קְנוֹבוֹת (pl.); Tosef. Shebi. VI, 2; Y. ib. VIII, 38ᵃ top. Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> [read:] <he>לטבלא … וק׳ י׳ בתוכה</he> a plate laid in with precious stones and jewels, and in it lie trimmings of vegetable (ed. Bub. <he>נקיבת ירק</he>, oth. ed. <he>נקובות ידים</he>); a. e.
